Title: Ayaan's Day

Cast

1. Ayaan - 11 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Anjali - 40 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Rohan - 9 years, friend
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Ayaan stands in the living room. Anjali stands near him.]

Ayaan: "What lovely weather!"

[Ayaan eats his breakfast at the table.]

Ayaan: "What happened?"

[Ayaan sips hot tea from a cup.]

Anjali: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
